summary: Iteration 93: Poids & Nutrition (Minceur) dashboard feature - permanent health section. Backend 100% pass (19/19 tests). Frontend fully functional with all required components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: minceur_routes.py: Clean implementation with proper BMI calculation, body composition, and AI recommendations via GPT-5.2
minceur.tsx: Well-structured with data-testid attributes on all major sections for testing
AI recommendations are cached daily per user (minceur_daily_cache collection)
Weight data properly filtered (30-200kg range) from device_readings collection
seed_data_creation: Test used existing device_readings (scale) data and minceur_goals created/deleted via API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Minceur feature at /minceur page with /api/minceur/* endpoints. Backend uses GPT-5.2 for AI meal/exercise recommendations. Weight data from device_readings collection (scale type). Goal setting invalidates daily cache to regenerate recommendations with new calorie budget.

backend_endpoints: GET /api/minceur/weight-details - returns profile, current weight/BMI, body composition, weight history, recommendations
POST /api/minceur/weight-goal - saves target weight and duration (2-52 weeks)
frontend_components: minceur-page: Main page container with dark theme
weight-hero: Current weight 79.2kg, BMI 25.9 (Surpoids), weight evolution chart
bmi-gauge: Color-coded gauge showing BMI position (blue/green/yellow/red zones)
body-composition: 4 rings (Graisse 26.4%, Muscle 40.5%, Hydratation 53.7%, Viscerale 10.9) + bone mass, body age, protein
goal-section: Definir un objectif button opens form with +/- weight selector and week duration (4s/8s/12s/16s/24s)
nora-insight: ANALYSE NORA AI insight on user's health status
calories-summary: Daily calorie budget with macros (proteins, carbs, lipids) and water intake
tab-meals / tab-exercises: Tab switching between Repas and Exercices
meals-section: 4 meal cards (breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner) with names, descriptions, calories, times
exercises-section: 2 exercise cards with name, duration, intensity badge, description, calories burned
tip-of-day: CONSEIL DU JOUR with daily health tip
health_tab_integration: Card shows current weight, IMC, mini sparkline chart

mocked_apis.note: All APIs use real data from MongoDB and real GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key for AI recommendations
